name: 16-shed-light-measured
incident: operator switched a shed light on 22:17:29, off 22:21:55
description:
MEASURED, not reconstructed. Source: cam-C.csv, 2026-08-17 22:16:00-22:23:00 local.

An outbuilding, light switched on for 266 s. BOTH pipelines are measured here: the machine probed into day at 22:18:05, so the day curve is real, not guessed. The night pipeline fell 12160 -> 3226 (factor 3.8) within one 5 s sample; the day pipeline then read ~3700 with the light on - well ABOVE the 768 default day_gain, which is the point: an absolute threshold calls this night while it is plainly a lit room.

Pipeline provenance - night curve: measured, day curve: measured. A curve marked 'inferred' has no measurement behind it in this window and pins nothing about that pipeline; only the 'measured' side carries evidence. ASSERTION, sharpened: the 266 s of light MUST produce a switch to day and back again. Four switches is the budget - the boot verification plus this one pair. More would mean the machine is oscillating; fewer would mean it missed the event.
